whatIs.title: What Are Lingual Braces?
whatIs.description: Lingual braces are orthodontic braces that are attached to the inner (tongue-facing) surface of the teeth rather than the front. They function similarly to traditional braces but remain hidden from view, making them an excellent option for patients who want a discreet orthodontic treatment. items.question: How do lingual braces work?
items.answer: Lingual braces are attached to the back surface of your teeth and gradually move them into proper alignment using gentle, controlled pressure.

items.question: Are lingual braces visible?
items.answer: No. Since they are placed behind the teeth, lingual braces remain virtually invisible during normal conversations and smiling.

items.question: Are lingual braces suitable for adults?
items.answer: Yes. Lingual braces are a popular option for adults and professionals who prefer discreet orthodontic treatment.

items.question: How long does lingual braces treatment take?
items.answer: Treatment duration varies depending on the complexity of your case. Your dentist will provide a personalized treatment timeline during your consultation.

items.question: Do lingual braces hurt?
items.answer: Patients may experience mild discomfort after placement or adjustments, which usually subsides within a few days as the mouth adapts.

items.question: What is the cost of lingual braces in Pune?
items.answer: The cost depends on individual treatment requirements, case complexity, and treatment duration. A detailed consultation provides an accurate estimate.

items.question: Why choose lingual braces over traditional braces?
items.answer: Lingual braces offer the same effective tooth movement as conventional braces while remaining hidden behind the teeth, making them ideal for patients seeking a discreet orthodontic solution.
